title: Read Log Entry
description: A trace that one session read one existing ledger record (material, fragment, question, motif, or session). This is the exhaustive 'who re-read what' log; curated interpretation belongs to relations, and text belongs to fragments/reports. One row per (session, target, reading) — append only, never rewritten. The reading field names what the session did with the record, not what the record means.

reading.description: quoted=一節をそのまま引いた / summarized=要約した / interpreted=解釈を加えた / reinterpreted=以前の読みに重ねて読み直した / contested=異議・反論として扱った / used_as_context=文脈として読んだ（討議の対象にしない） / counted=監査・集計の対象として数えただけ
